name: codex-trajectory
description: Inspect local Codex task trajectories as a privacy-aware event ledger and timeline.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect turns, tools, tokens, and timing in local Codex tasks.
interface.longDescription: A privacy-aware trajectory viewer for local Codex tasks. Its MCP tools provide read-only safe summaries, opt-in bounded details, an interactive event ledger, an adaptive live window with direct stop controls when loopback CDP is enabled, and a shortcut that opens the complete viewer in the Codex in-app Browser.
defaultPrompt: Show the safe trajectory summary for this Codex task.
Inspect my latest task and identify its slowest tool calls.
